_meta.what: Registered think-tank roster for the expert-attention layer (practitioner item 3). Titles and links only, never content. Institutions without a public feed are listed with that status rather than dropped: the roster is the registration, collection covers the feed-publishing subset, and feed discovery is revisited monthly. Spectrum note: the Indian institutions span independent to official-leaning; disclosed in the codebook so the roster cannot be read as ideologically curated.
_meta.match_rule: an item is tagged to a channel when its title or summary contains any of that channel's registered dictionary phrases (normalized token subsequence); items matching no channel are kept as general roster output
